notes.title: Release date!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We are delighted to announce that Ku: Shroud of the Morrigan will launch on Steam on March 17th!

What better way to celebrate St.Patricks Day then to consume yourself in some ancient Irish history ;)

For those of you that grabbed the game in the recent IndieGameStand deal, you will be able to access the game from this date.

Visit www.bitSmithGames.com and subscribe to our mailing list for updates for Ku and our other titles in development.

All the best,
The bitSmith Games team
